query:
SELECT b.id, b.scheduled_date, b.scheduled_time, br.reminder_24h_sent, br.reminder_1h_sent, 
TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, NOW(), b.scheduled_date) as hours_until_appointment
FROM bookings b
LEFT JOIN booking_reminders br ON b.id = br.booking_id
WHERE b.scheduled_date IS NOT NULL AND b.status = 'confirmed'
ORDER BY b.scheduled_date ASC;
